Parineeti Chopra's Netflix Series 'Shaque' Announces Release Date

Actress Parineeti Chopra's debut web series, titled 'Shaque: Trust No One', is set to premiere on Netflix. The streaming platform announced the release date and unveiled a poster for the show. The series marks Chopra's entry into the web series format.
